How Example Widgets Inc. decides where to spend on ads

Return on ad spend (ROAS) drives the budget, and paid search wins most quarters.

In depth

Why ad spend is judged by ROAS

Example Widgets Inc. judges every channel by ROAS, the revenue earned for each dollar spent, net of refunds since Q3. A channel with a ROAS of 4 returns four dollars for every dollar. See the pricing page.

ROAS · return on ad spend

Revenue earned for each dollar spent on ads. A ROAS of 4 means $4 back per $1 spent.

  • Paid search: intent is high, so conversion is strong
  • Social: cheap reach, weaker conversion
  • Email: tiny cost, utm tagged
  • Affiliate: paid only on sales, but its buyers return the most widgets
conversion

When a visitor becomes a buyer.

Key point

A ROAS below 1 means the channel loses money before any other cost.

Note

Refunds are netted out from Q3 onward, so earlier quarters look slightly better than they were.

2. How the budget moved

Budget shifted toward search over the year, while display was cut. ROAS stayed the north star.

Returns eat into the return

About 6% of widgets sold online come back, and every point of refund rate lowers the ROAS a channel really earns.

Refund rate

The share of sales that buyers return for their money back.

Return rate by channel, Q3

Paid search4%

How an order flows

From click to delivery

  1. Click

    A shopper clicks a search ad.

  2. Buy

    They buy a widget; revenue is attributed to search.

  3. Ship

    The warehouse ships within two days.

  1. Only: A stepper with one step becomes a list.

Think of it like

ROAS is like a vending machine that tells you how many snacks each coin buys.

Warning

Attribution windows change ROAS. <script>alert(1)</script> is shown as text.

Attribution window

How long after a click a sale still counts for the ad.

ELI5

Money in, money out

A company pays for ads. Some ads bring back lots of money, and some bring back only a little. When a buyer sends a widget back, the company gives that money back too.

Think of it like

It is like planting seeds: some seeds grow big plants, some grow tiny ones.

Picking the best ads

The company keeps the ads that bring back the most money, like search ads.

When things come back

If a toy breaks, you might take it back to the shop. Shops count that too.
